reviewNotes.terrain: 15 grass routes use new temperate grass; 5 snow-material routes use old compacted snow with litter. Existing segment surfaces and surface-specific road/shoulder refs retained.
reviewNotes.projectionLimit: Native Thompson view exposes vertical extrusion bands above and below source art; this is not accepted as clean full-pitch art. Actual driving foreground hides some lower extension; representative production must be evaluated separately.
reviewNotes.night: Six clear-night .05 variants have restrained crescent/star cues in original art; actual authored visibility may suppress them. No release brightness override.
reviewNotes.sourceMetrics: 15 source images have lower-row-extension warnings; one also has horizontal-wrap warning (Brandywine). Decoded global seam metric has no new warnings, which does not supersede visual review.
